entities.title: Page
entities.summary: The game's HTML page, its styles and the headers Cloudflare serves with it.
entities.purpose: Holds what the build copies unchanged into dist/: index.html with the canvas, the keypad, the sound button, the two screen-reader live regions and the site's footer links; zx.css, which lays them out for desktop, phone portrait and phone landscape; and _headers with the content security policy.
boundaries: No game code: the build adds game.js from src/main.ts, which finds its elements by the ids zx, keypad, controls, sound, screen-text and screen-alert.
/games/play.js, which the page also loads, is the games hub's.
build.mjs skips this .dev/ when it copies the folder, so it is never served (games/.dev/decisions.json, publish-dev-files).
